title: Right-triangle foundations
sentences: In a right triangle, the hypotenuse is the longest side and sits opposite the 90° angle.
The squares of the two legs add to the square of the hypotenuse.
This relationship only applies to right triangles.
To find a leg, subtract the other leg's square from the hypotenuse's square.
A right triangle has legs 6 m and 8 m.
